buildCommand: cd web && npm ci && npm run build
_comment_regions: Next to the database, not next to the users. Reading one tournament takes five queries; with the function in Frankfurt and Neon in Virginia that was five Atlantic crossings per request, ~1.1s measured. Co-located it is one crossing — the user's — and the queries cost a millisecond each. Move this back to fra1 the day the database moves to eu-central-1, and not before.
